criteria.description: Grounds the design in the viral math — estimates k (invites/user × conversion) and reasons from it, rather than assuming virality.
Honestly assesses whether the program can be viral (k≥1) or is realistically a CAC-reducer (k<1), pushing back on the 'go viral' framing rather than echoing it.
Sizes the incentive against CAC/LTV (a free month ≈ $8 cost; CAC $25; LTV $90) and prefers two-sided, ideally paid on activation/payment rather than raw signup.
Specifies when/how the referral is requested (a value/delight moment, one-tap) to drive invites per user.
Includes abuse/fraud guardrails (self-referral, fake signups farming the free month) and a success metric / kill criterion.
